title: haz (hazlo), wherever / however / whatever with the mood tense, seguir, sea

cards.title: haz = do! (irregular)
cards.body: Not 'hace'. Z sounds like th in much of Spain.

cards.title: Mood tense turns where → wherever
cards.body: Donde quieres = where you want; donde quieras = wherever you want.

cards.title: how → however; what → whatever
cards.body: This use is optional: the plain present is fine Spanish too, just without the '-ever' feeling.

cards.title: Two mood tenses in one sentence
cards.body: Comes lo que prefieras ('you eat whatever…') sounds softer; the command is come.

examples.en: Eat whatever you prefer (informal / formal / all).
examples.es: Come lo que prefieras. / Coma lo que prefiera. / Coman lo que prefieran.

cards.title: seguir = to follow / continue (e → i)
cards.body: Like elegir: sigo, sigue, siguen, but seguimos. The same pattern in conseguir (to get / manage to) and perseguir (to chase).

examples.en: I'll follow you wherever you go.

cards.title: ser → sea; o sea; sea lo que sea
cards.body: O sea ('or it might be') is a filler, like 'I mean…'.

examples.en: I'd prefer it to be like this.
Whatever it is / whatever will be
